name: Hotel Weisseespitze
beschreibung: Hotel Weisseespitze is nestled in Feichten within the pristine Kaunertal Valley, framed by the towering glaciated summits of the Ötztal Alps. The hotel is widely celebrated for its genuine Tyrolean warmth and award-winning barrier-free design. A comprehensive wellness center includes an indoor swimming pool, diverse saunas, steam rooms, and Kneipp facilities for post-hike relaxation. Dining revolves around healthy regional cuisine made from valley-sourced alpine ingredients. In winter, the high-altitude Kaunertal Glacier ski slopes and local cross-country tracks provide snow-sure sports, while summer turns the region into an unspoiled hiking paradise.
kurzbeschreibung: Nature and wellness hotel in Kaunertal featuring accessible facilities, an indoor pool, and alpine dining.
